title: Wasserstein Fair Classification
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The study focuses on fair classification and measures demographic parity with respect to sensitive attributes like race, gender, and age.
findings: The paper has no findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the study.
